latHint: Think a paycheck at the end of the week.
pivHint: DOUGH is the soft mixture bakers knead and roll into loaves. In everyday slang, it is also what people earn and spend.
winText: Rolling in it. DOUGH was the pivot - a baker's DOUGH to the slang for MONEY.
lossText: MONEY - what people earn and spend. DOUGH was the pivot: bakers knead DOUGH to make bread, and in slang, DOUGH is another word for MONEY.
